categories.main_business_segments: EXL operates through four primary business segments: Insurance, Healthcare, Analytics, and Emerging Business. Each segment is aligned with specific industry verticals and is responsible for service delivery, customer satisfaction, growth, and profitability. The Analytics segment was strengthened by the acquisition of Clairvoyant AI Inc. in December 2021.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: EXL leverages advanced data analytics, artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), cloud computing, and automation technologies. The company integrates these technologies into client workflows using proprietary platforms (e.g., AI:OS, Xtrakto.AI, Exelia.AI, Paymentor, LifePRO, LISS, Subrosource, CareRadius, EXLClarity, EXLVantage) and agile delivery models to automate and optimize business processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: EXL primarily serves large corporations in the insurance, healthcare, banking and financial services, media, retail, utilities, travel, transportation, logistics, and manufacturing sectors. Its key customers include property and casualty insurers, healthcare payers and providers, banks, fintechs, and retail organizations, with a focus on Fortune 500 and Global 2000 companies.
categories.geographic_coverage: EXL is headquartered in New York and operates globally with more than 50 offices across six continents. The majority of its revenues are generated from clients in the United States (85.9% in 2021) and the United Kingdom (9.4%), with additional operations in India, the Philippines, Colombia, South Africa, Bulgaria, Romania, the Czech Republic, and Australia.
categories.supply_chain_position: EXL operates as a downstream service provider, delivering business process management, digital operations, and analytics solutions directly to end clients. It acts as a strategic partner, embedding its services into clients’ business processes and customer engagement workflows.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: EXL’s strategic priorities include expanding services in large addressable markets, deepening domain expertise, integrating analytics and digital capabilities, cultivating long-term client relationships, optimizing its global delivery footprint, and pursuing selective acquisitions and partnerships. R&D efforts focus on enhancing AI, ML, cloud, and analytics capabilities, developing scalable industry solutions, and building multi-cloud analytics platforms.
categories.revenue_model: EXL generates revenue primarily through long-term service contracts using various pricing models, including time-and-material, full-time-equivalent, transaction-based, outcome-based, and subscription-based arrangements. Analytics services are delivered via both project-based and annuity contracts, while SaaS and BPaaS models are used for certain proprietary platforms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: EXL faces intense competition from large global BPM and IT companies such as Accenture, Cognizant, Genpact, Infosys, NTT DATA, Tata Consultancy Services, and WNS, as well as niche providers like Cotiviti and Optum Health, and leading consulting/accounting firms. EXL differentiates itself through deep industry expertise, integrated analytics, innovative digital solutions, and strong client relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2021, EXL generated $1.12 billion in revenue, representing 17.1% year-over-year growth. The company employs approximately 37,400 people worldwide and maintains a strong financial position, with significant investments in technology and global delivery capabilities. Revenue is diversified across 459 clients, with no single client accounting for more than 10% of total revenues.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: EXL’s value proposition centers on being an indispensable partner for data-led business transformation, delivering measurable business outcomes through advanced analytics, AI-powered digital solutions, and deep domain expertise. Its agile, scalable solutions, proprietary platforms, and integrated approach enable clients to accelerate decision-making, optimize costs, and enhance customer experiences.
